build_FP16Optimizer: build an FP16 optimizer wrapper that maintains FP32 master params for mixed precision training
build_MemoryEfficientFP16Optimizer: build a memory efficient FP16 optimizer that avoids keeping FP32 master parameter copies
build_fp32_params: build FP32 copies of model parameters with optional flattening for mixed precision training
backward_FP16Optimizer: run backward pass on loss with dynamic loss scaling to prevent gradient underflow in FP16
clip_grad_norm_FP16Optimizer: clip gradient norm and update the dynamic loss scaler during FP16 training
